created_prompt: I need a three year plan on how to write and publish a cookbook. I need to brainstorm ideas on what recipes I can include in the book. My followers love quick and healthy recipes, so these recipes shouldn't take more than 30 minutes to make. I need ideas on what publishing avenues I can take, and pros and cons on traditional vs. self-publishing. I am willing to spend no more than $2000 to make this book, and I can work at most 10 hours per week on this book.
